 15 Best Deals In Singapore This Week – 2nd-8th November 2026 
 Khoo Yong Hao 
 • 
 02 Nov 2026 
 • 
 Sales & Promotions 
 • 
 11 minutes reading time 
 Best deals in Singapore this week 
 If there’s one essential life skill Singaporeans are equipped with by default, it’s the coveted ability to scour far and wide for the best deals and promos in Singapore . After all, saving a few bucks here and there never hurt anyone, and your bank balance will thank you in the long run. From home essentials to foodie treats, here are some of the best ones we’ve sussed out this week.
 Table of Contents
 Best deals in Singapore this week 1. Commune by Metropolitan YMCA new buffets promo 
 2. FairPrice $5 return vouchers 
 3. Sushiro Bukit Panjang Plaza outlet opening promotion 
 4. The Soup Expert 1st Anniversary promotion 
 5. Watsons Go Green campaign 
 6. Shin Katsu 1-for-1 katsu sets 
 7. SAFRA members 1-for-1 Universal Studios Singapore tickets 
 8. Ume San 100 Konbini sets 
 9. Bochinche Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet 
 10. Buttercup & Kuromi SimplyGo EZ-Link charms 
 11. Crayon Shinchan x Genki Sushi 
 12. iCloud+ subscription promotion 
 13. REINVENTION: ALLPLAY PlayCourt 
 14. DBS PayLah! cashback campaign 
 15. Marriott Bonvoy Never-Ending Staycation 
 1. Commune by Metropolitan YMCA new buffets promo 
 1-for-1 deal on new lunch & dinner buffets 
 Image credit: Commune by Metropolitan YMCA 
 For those with a ravenous appetite, bring a buddy for Commune by Metropolitan YMCA ’s new buffets. They’ve got a tasty 1-for-1 promotion on their refreshed lunch and dinner buffets , each featuring their own spread of delectable bites.
 Image credit: Commune by Metropolitan YMCA 
 Swing by from 12pm to 2pm for their lunch buffet (from $48) to feast on a yummy selection of local faves such as curry fish head, claypot chicken rice, and rojak. Meanwhile, the dinner buffet (from $72) takes its place from 6pm to 9pm , and promises unlimited meats and sides, which include the likes of steaks, duck leg confit, and truffle mac and cheese to close out your night.
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 2. FairPrice $5 return vouchers 
 Free $5 return voucher with every $50 spent 
 You’ll want to go for your grocery runs at FairPrice soon, as they’ll be handing out a free $5 return voucher for every $50 spent. You can redeem up to 4 vouchers per transaction when you shop at their supermarkets from now till 9th November 2026 . What’s more, these $5 vouchers can be used with no minimum spend requirement.
 Do note that you can only use them 1 day after their date of issuance, and be sure to cash them in before 30th November 2026 as they expire then.
 Promo period: Now till 9th November 2026
 3. Sushiro Bukit Panjang Plaza outlet opening promotion 
 1-for-1 deal on select sushi 
 With how fast Sushiro is expanding within the Little Red Dot, it feels like there’s a new outlet opening every other month. This time, folks residing in Bukit Panjang won’t have to travel far to gobble up their fresh sushi, as the chain will be calling Bukit Panjang Plaza home too. To celebrate, they’re serving up 1-for-1 sushi deals for the next week and a half:
 1st-2nd Nov: Big Cut Salmon Belly with Ikura (from $3.90)
 3rd-5th Nov: Big Red Shrimp (from $2.30)
 6th-7th Nov: Big Cut Fresh Salmon (from $2.90)
 8th-9th Nov: Jumbo Scallop (from $4.90)
 10th-12th Nov: Medium Fatty Tuna (from $3.90)
 Promo period: Now till 12th November 2026
 4. The Soup Expert 1st Anniversary promotion 
 Enjoy $1 soups with a minimum spend of $29.90 
 Image credit: Eatbook 
 As we inch closer to the end of the year, the monsoon season’s fast approaching, which means there’ll be more rainy days to come. If you’re ever caught in the storm, duck into Suntec City and warm up with a nourishing brew at The Soup Expert . They are celebrating their 1st anniversary , and you’ll be able to enjoy their delectable soups for just a dollar.
 Yes, you heard right; simply rack up a minimum spend of $29.90 , and you can enjoy 1 selected soup for just $1 . Diners who spend at least $59.80 get to slurp on 2 selected soups at $1 each .
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 5. Watsons Go Green campaign 
 Free La Roche-Posay gift set worth $30​ & $5 voucher when you recycle bottles 
 Do a little good for Mother Earth by taking part in the ongoing Watsons Go Green campaign ; you’ll be well-rewarded for your efforts too. Simply visit any of their participating outlets and recycle your empty product bottles to redeem a La Roche-Posay gift set worth $30 along with a $5 off voucher that you can use when spending at least $60 on La Roche-Posay items​.
 They’ll accept plastic bottles of at least 50ml, from products like shampoos, conditioners, body wash, hand creams, and detergents just to name a few. Also, ensure that the bottles you donate are clean, dry, and residue-free.
 Visit the Watsons Singapore website for the full list of participating outlets and acceptable recyclables.
 Promo period: Now till 11th November 2026
 6. Shin Katsu 1-for-1 katsu sets 
 1-for-1 deal on new Hirata Rosu Katsu Sets every Monday 
 Image adapted from: Shin Katsu 
 You don’t have to hop on a plane to Japan to savour the deep-fried delicacy that is tonkatsu, because Shin Katsu ’s crunchy offerings are as authentic as it gets. In fact, they’re the only tonkatsu restaurant on the island that serves up premium Hirata Farm pork , which is renowned for its rich marbling and exceptional tenderness.
 If you’re already watering at the mouth, now’s the time to head over. The restaurant has a 1-for-1 deal on their new Hirata Rosu Katsu sets ($36.80 ) available every Monday throughout the months of November and December . Masterfully prepared, the set features a light, crispy panko coating, which captures and complements the pork’s natural juiciness.
 Promo period: 1st November-31st December 2026
 7. SAFRA members 1-for-1 Universal Studios Singapore tickets 
 Member-exclusive 1-for-1 adult USS tickets & discounted child admission 
 We’re giving you the go-ahead to hound your friends and relatives who happen to be SAFRA members . That’s because they’ve got a member-exclusive, 1-for-1 deal for adult Universal Studios Singapore tickets . You heard right; to honour 59 years of National Service, SAFRA’s egging you on to bring your family out for a day of fun at USS with this attractive promo.
 The little ones can also come along for the ride, as they can enjoy $10 off admission tickets as well ($59, U.P. $69) . The promo runs till the end of the year, so an outing is definitely in the books once school’s out.
 Book 1-for-1 tickets to Universal Studios Singapore .
 Promo period: Now till 31st December 2026
 8. Ume San 100 Konbini sets 
 New set meals that come with a surprise freebie 
 When you think the literal hidden gem that is Ume San 100 can’t get any quirkier, they’re making visits extra interesting with their new Konbini set meals (from $19.90) .
 Inspired by the quintessential convenience store runs you’ve simply got to make whenever you’re in Japan, the set comprises a distinctly flavoured Truffle Ramen served alongside Umechicki , a playful, plum-infused take on the konbini staple. The set also comes with a bottle of refreshing Ume Cola , as well as a surprise freebie that we won’t spoil just yet.
 Promo period: Now till further notice
 9. Bochinche Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet 
 Free-flow steaks from $55/pax & attractive weekday deals 
 Image credit: Bochinche 
 Meat lovers should be no strangers to Bochinche , an Argentine steakhouse and bar over on Club Street. In case you’re not in the know, they’ve got a 90-minute Weekend Free-Flow Steak Lunch Buffet available on Saturdays, Sundays, and Public Holidays, which is just music to the ears of anyone trying to hit their daily protein intake.
Image credit: Bochinche 
 For just $55/pax , you’ll get to feast on unlimited servings of signature Argentinian steaks straight off the grill. But if that’s not enough to satisfy your meaty cravings, the Argentine Butcher’s Board (from $236) is perfect for an indulgent feast; it features a 1.4kg platter of Ribeye , Tenderloin , Sirloin , Rump Cap , and House Chorizo , surely enough to go around.
 Should weekend visits elude you, the restaurant also has deals from Mondays through Thursdays , making weekday meals here mighty attractive:
 Mondays 6pm-9pm: 1-for-1 200g steaks (Argentina Ribeye/Sirloin)
 Tuesdays: Complimentary all-day corkage
 Wednesdays 6pm-9pm: Discounted Argentinian Butcher’s Board from $185
 Thursdays 6pm-8pm: 50% off signature cocktails
 Promo period: Now till further notice
 10. Buttercup & Kuromi SimplyGo EZ-Link charms 
 New EZ-Link charms available at SimplyGo vending machines in malls 
Image credit: @caelanmoriaty_0412 via Carousell 
 We know how enamoured we Singaporeans can get with EZ-Link charms , so here’s a new one to add to the collection. This time, Sanrio has joined hands with the ever-popular Powerpuff Girls to bring us a set of adorable Buttercup and Kuromi SimplyGo EZ-Link charms ($14.90) .
 These just dropped earlier this week, so if you’re keen on getting one yourself, swing by a SimplyGo vending machine in a mall near you before they’re all snapped up. You can visit the SimplyGo website for a full list of their vending machine locations.
 Promo period: Now till further notice
 11. Crayon Shinchan x Genki Sushi 
 New collaboration menu & Crayon Shinchan merch up for grabs 
 Swing by a Genki Sushi outlet from 24th September to 8th November 2026 , and you’ll realise that the mischievous Crayon Shinchan has infiltrated the Japanese sushi chain.
 Image adapted from: Genki Sushi 
 Fans can get a taste of a new menu specially cooked up for this cheeky collaboration, which includes dishes like the Signature Cheesy Ebi Fry Taco , Shinchan Cheeky Chicken Katsu Rice , and Miso Butter Corn Ramen to name a few. Not only that, a limited-time line of merch will also be released, featuring Crayon Shinchan and gang.
 Image credit: Genki Sushi  
 Every $50 spent will grant you a gachapon-style spin where you can win Genki Sushi vouchers , as well as a Shinchan Cup Holder , Phone Strap , and Cable Clips . A Shinchan Thermal Lunch Bag is also up for grabs for $10.90 , or $7.90 and $6.90 for DBS/POSB card members and Genki Sushi members respectively .
Image credit: Genki Sushi  
 Another added perk of being a Genki Sushi member is that you’ll get exclusive access to an adorable Shinchan Hoodie for $25.90 , available for purchase in-store.
 Promo period: Now till 8th November 2026
 12. iCloud+ subscription promotion 
 Free access to Apple TV & Apple Arcade with iCloud+ subscription 
 If you already got first dibs on the new iPhone 18 through pre-orders, you might also want to consider upgrading your iCloud subscription too. For the uninitiated, iCloud+ (from $1.48/month) is a paid subscription which gives users more storage space on Apple’s iCloud cloud syncing service, along with certain privacy tools.
 Severance, a sci-fi psychological thriller television series only available on Apple TV.
 Image credit: Apple TV 
 They’ve recently rolled out a new promotion, where Apple users who subscribe to iCloud+ can also enjoy free access to Apple TV and Apple Arcade . Even if you don’t have much use for the extra storage space, you can share your plan with up to 5 family members who might need it more, for no extra cost.
 Subscribe to Apple’s iCloud+ .
 Promo period: Now till further notice
 13. REINVENTION: ALLPLAY PlayCourt 
 Free pickleball courts, table tennis tables & basketball hoops 
 For sporty folks looking for somewhere to sweat it out, look no further than REINVENTION: ALLPLAY happening right now at Geneo . PlayCourt is one of the 3 interactive zones set up for the festival, and it’s where you can have a go at a couple of sports entirely for free , no booking required .
 Image credit: Geneo 
 There are 2 pickleball courts to dink to your hearts’ content, 2 table tennis tables , as well as 4 basketball hoops to practice sinking your 3s. Best part is, all equipment is provided on site; just be considerate and treat them like your own, and keep playtime to a minimum of 2 hours to give others a chance to have a go too.
 Promo period: Now till 22nd November 2026
 14. DBS PayLah! cashback campaign 
 Up to $3 cashback at participating heartland merchants & hawkers 
 Good news for folks looking to save on their coffeeshop runs during the weekends, as DBS is bringing back their PayLah! cashback campaign .
 On Saturdays only from now till 19th December 2026 , you can enjoy up to $3 in cashback whenever you use their app to pay for your purchases at participating heartland shops, wet markets, coffeeshops and hawkers islandwide. Do note that the $3 cashback is limited to the first 160,000 redemptions islandwide, starting at 6am .
 Learn more about DBS’ PayLah! cashback campaign .
 Promo period: Now till 19th December 2026
 15. Marriott Bonvoy Never-Ending Staycation 
 Promo code for free daily breakfast for 2 & dinner at specialty restaurant 
 The Singapore Marriott Tang Plaza Hotel.
 Image credit: Marriott  
 There’s no shame in booking a staycay right here in sunny Singapore to stave off the corporate burnout, and Marriott Bonvoy concurs. As part of their latest Never-Ending Staycation promotion, simply key in the code <HOL> when booking your stays at any one of their 19 hotels on the Little Red Dot to enjoy the following:
 Free daily breakfasts for 2
 1 dinner for 2 with at least 3 courses & a drink each at a speciality or all-day dining  restaurant
 Up to 2 kids under 12 years of age dine for free with a paying adult
 Book a stay at a Marriott Bonvoy hotel .
 Promo period: Now till 23rd December 2026
 Make the most of this week’s best deals in Singapore 
 With massive discounts and offers ranging from tech and travel to lifestyle and F&B, there’s something for everyone in this week’s roundup of top deals in Singapore. Just be sure to act fast, as many of these promos are only valid for a short time, and once they’re gone, they’re gone. Happy bargain hunting!
